# Company Overview
Auro Pumps Pvt. Ltd. is a specialist manufacturer of critical-application industrial pumps, established in 1984 through a technology transfer from Pompe Vergani SpA of Italy. Based in Palej, Bharuch, Gujarat, the company has built decades of expertise in pump manufacturing, proprietary metallurgy, and materials know-how. With a range of over 20 different pump series, Auro Pumps offers process- and fluid-specific pumping solutions for molten metals, molten salts, slurries, and other critical industrial fluids, serving industries including chemicals, petrochemicals, steel, galvanizing, solar, and nuclear sectors, both in India and globally.
 
## Key Capabilities
- **Molten Metal Pumps**: In-house designed and manufactured pumps for molten Zinc, Lead, Aluminium, Galvalume, Tin, and Magnesium handling.
- **Molten Salt Pumps & Systems**: Proprietary, specially engineered pumps and complete loop/heater/valve systems for molten salt up to 800°C, serving chemical, solar, and nuclear sectors.
- **Slurry & Cantilever Pumps**: Vertical heavy slurry pumps engineered for the most abrasive, erosive, and corrosive slurries, including high-concentration and large-particle applications.
- **Magnetic Drive Pumps**: ACMAG series leak-free, containment-shell-sealed pumps for chemical, molten salt, molten metal, and hot oil transfer.
- **Non-Metallic & Vertical Submerged Pumps**: APPV series non-metallic vertical PP pumps and ACCV series vertical submerged pumps for corrosive and solvent applications.
- **Snout Pumps**: Pump-based snout de-drossing (push-pull) systems for Zinc/Galvalume continuous galvanizing lines.
- **High Temperature & High Pressure Pumps**: Air/water-cooled thermic fluid pumps (up to 410°C) and high-pressure chemical & LPG pumps (up to 300°C).
- **Global Presence**: Pumps exported to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bangladesh, Tanzania, Egypt, and other international markets.
